plan.title: Asset PR to Reverse Auction PO

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is possible.
Give the event a searchable title required for publishing and later history verification.
Set and commit the 30-minute event duration.
Invite exactly two QA vendors so Vendor A and Vendor B can submit competing bids.

args.goal: On the buyer event creation screen, add one required Terms and Conditions clause and leave the screen showing the saved clause.

steps.note: Perform the required T&C action, which has no dedicated catalog step or assertion.
Publish the completed auction event.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Submit the first invited vendor's quote at 100 through the vendor portal.
Assert that the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Submit the next invited vendor's quote at 90 through a separate vendor portal session.
Assert that the second vendor's bid was accepted.
Wait for bidding to end before opening Master QCS and awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after bidding has ended.
Assert that ranking follows the lowest bid amount.
Assert that the second bidding vendor, who quoted 90, is Rank 1.
Allocate the complete award to the lowest vendor, create the proposal, and submit it.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for Asset PR reverse auction award.

steps.note: Approve the submitted award with the required approver remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase order for the awarded vendor.
Assert that one PO contains the awarded PR line with the stated quantity.
Return to the events list to verify the event reached history.
Open the History tab after the event lifecycle completed.
Assert that this plan's event appears in event history.
